note: Findings of the screen size matrix (track VP, day 4). mkknown.cjs gives every measured failure the id of the first finding below whose match fits; REPORT.md (autoloop/day4/viewport) explains each. Findings with "eye" were judged from the pictures and have no rule.

findings.title: iPad landscape: the town is drawn 5.6 to 6.6 times its size; the hero is a quarter of the screen high and only three rows of the town are in view
findings.numbers: iPad 1180x820: town zoom 5.625, hero 202 px high = 25% of the screen height, 210 x 146 town px in view. iPad Pro 1366x1024: zoom 6.563, hero 236 px = 23%, 208 x 156 in view. For comparison iPad portrait: zoom 3.75, hero 135 px = 11%, 219 x 315 in view; phones: zoom 1.875, hero 68 px = 7 to 10%, 200 to 229 x 356 to 497 in view. The hero is 36 town px tall, so landscape shows about four hero heights of town.
findings.cause: public/act1-hifi/town.html:378 `camera.zoom = width / VIEW_W` (VIEW_W = 208, line 351): the zoom follows the width only, so a wide and short screen loses its height. The art is also magnified past what its pixels carry (blocky paving and props in the pictures).
findings.fix: Bound the zoom by the height as well: `camera.zoom = Math.min(width / VIEW_W, height / 300)` (300 town px is about what iPad portrait shows), then the existing whole-pixel snap. iPad landscape then shows about 430 x 300 town px at zoom about 2.7, hero about 98 px. Greenhollow is 768 px wide, so the wider view still fits inside the map.

findings.title: iPad landscape 1180x820: Create Your Hero does not fit; the Start Game button is cut off by the bottom edge and the form has to be scrolled
findings.numbers: Form content 882 px in a 796 px box: 86 px too tall. At rest only the top edge of Start Game shows at the bottom of the screen. iPad Pro landscape 1366x1024 fits. iPad mini landscape (1133x744, not in the size list, not run) is 76 px shorter again, so it will be worse there.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css tablet landscape block (`@media (min-width:700px) and (orientation:landscape) and (min-height:560px)`, about line 472): `--z:1.32` and the two-column `.grid2`. Hero preview, two rows of cards and the button come to 882 px at zoom 1.32. The rule that hides the hero preview on short screens (`@media (max-height:720px)`, line 941) does not reach 820.
findings.fix: In the landscape block hide (or halve) the hero preview up to 900 px of height: `@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:900px) { #qok-ui .span2:has(> .intro-hero){ display:none } }`. The Look card already shows the hero.

findings.title: Overworld and dungeons: a dark band under the status bar, where town and battle paint to the top edge
findings.pictures: sheets/overworld-en.jpg against sheets/town-arrive-en.jpg and sheets/battle-start-en.jpg; shots/i13-en-overworld.jpg, shots/promax-en-overworld.jpg
findings.numbers: Band of the page colour rgb(10,10,20) as high as the top inset: 20 px on SE, 47 on iPhone 13, 59 on Pro Max, 24 on the iPads. Colour step against the map 136 to 162 on the overworld (out of 255), 9 to 11 in dark dungeons. The game canvas starts at y = inset (overworld canvas 0,47 390x701 on iPhone 13); the town frame and the battle backdrop start at y = 0.
findings.cause: index.html:90 `#game-container { top: env(safe-area-inset-top) }`: the Phaser canvas stops below the inset and the page background shows above it. Town (iframe) and battle (`#qok-ui` backdrop) cover the whole screen, so the game changes its top edge between screens.
findings.fix: Let the canvas fill the screen (`top:0; height:100%`) and keep the inset only on the HUD, which already adds it (HP chip at inset + 6 px). Then re-check the hero against the joystick, because the camera centre moves up by half the inset.

findings.title: iPhone SE: Settings does not fit; Title Screen lies under the tab bar until the list is scrolled
findings.numbers: Settings list 573 px in a 514 px box (59 px over). The centre of the Title Screen button (187, 627) is under the tab bar at rest; it can be reached by scrolling. The other seven sizes fit.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css settings rows (`.setrow`) keep their full height on a 667 px screen: seven rows plus the Title Screen button. The Testers row (VP-13) is one of the seven; with it off the list is one row shorter and may just fit: measure again then.
findings.fix: Under `@media (max-height:700px)` cut the vertical padding of `#qok-ui .setrow` by 4 px a row, or leave it as it is once the Testers row is gone and the check shows it fits.

findings.title: iPad landscape: bosses reach up behind the enemy name bar
findings.numbers: iPad 1180x820: boss picture box starts at y 78, the name bar ends at y 104 (26 px under it, 10,381 px2). iPad Pro 1366x1024: y 66 against 104 (38 px, 20,032 px2). Portrait sizes and regular enemies: no overlap.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css tablet landscape block: `#qok-ui.battle .bstage{ height:52% }` with the boss fit box at `max-height:74%`, and the name bar zoomed 1.25 on top of the same stage. The stage does not leave room for the bar.
findings.fix: In the landscape block give the stage a top padding of the name bar's height (about 96 px) or cap `.bfit.boss` at 62% of the stage.

findings.title: Tab bar labels are 11 px on every size, and do not grow on iPad
findings.numbers: Field tabs (Status, Items, Equip, Settings) 11 px; menu tabs 11 px. Same 11 px on a 1024 px wide iPad Pro, where the menu body is zoomed 1.4.
findings.cause: index.html `.field-tabs .ft span` (lines 64 to 80) and public/ui-overhaul.css:135 `.tab` set 11 px; line 446 keeps `.tabbar` out of the tablet zoom.
findings.fix: 12 px on phones; 14 px and a 24 px icon from 700 px of width.

findings.title: Phones: small print in the menus is 10 to 11.5 px
findings.numbers: Top bar Lv and HP 10 px (11 px on Pro Max); section headings (Status, Equip) 11 px; equip filter labels (Weapon, Armor ...) 10 px; New pill 10 px; Owned heading 11 px; item and shop descriptions 11.5 px; save slot label (Slot 1) 11 px on every size. On iPads the menu zoom of 1.4 lifts all but the slot label over 12 px.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css: `@media (max-width:420px)` sets `.who-meta, .top-hp-num, .who .lv` to 10 px (lines 448 to 456); `.eyebrow` 11 px (line 110); `.segcat b` 10 px (line 252); `.newpill` (line 794); `.slotcard .sn` 11 px (line 835).

findings.title: Compass letters are 8.5 and 10 px
findings.numbers: E, S, W 8.5 px, N 10 px, on every size (the compass is 68 px on phones and tablets).
findings.fix: Keep only N at 12 px, or grow the compass with the screen (VP-17).

findings.title: iPhone SE: the notepad's four tool buttons are squeezed to 44 x 34
findings.numbers: Pen, Eraser, Clear and Close measure 44 x 34 px (hittable 45 x 41) in a slate 178 px high; 44 x 44 on every other size (slate 292 px or more).
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.js `npPlace()` (about line 2171) gives the slate the room between the name bar and the quiz card, 178 px on SE; public/ui-overhaul.css:1010 `.nptools` is a column with 8 px gaps, and four 44 px buttons need 216 px, so they shrink.
findings.fix: `flex-shrink:0` on the buttons and two columns of two when the slate is under 220 px high, or move Close to the top left corner.

findings.title: Phones: rows of the grade wheel on Create Your Hero are 32 px high
findings.numbers: Each grade row 31.7 px high (hittable 33 px) on SE, iPhone 13 and Pro Max. The wheel can also be dragged, so a row tap is not the only way.
findings.fix: 44 px rows (the wheel then shows three rows in 132 px).

findings.title: iPhone SE: the opened Quests panel covers the hero's left edge
findings.numbers: Panel right edge at x 163, hero from x 155: 8 px over, 531 px2. Other sizes clear. The panel is open only when asked for (and for 4 s when a quest is added).
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css quest panel width 156 px at left 7 px on a 375 px screen whose centre is 187.
findings.fix: Cap the open panel at 140 px wide below 380 px of width.

findings.title: Phones: on entering a town the hero stands under the joystick ring
findings.numbers: Overlap of the hero and the 172 px joystick ring just inside the south gate: 2,346 px2 on SE, 1,886 on iPhone 13, 659 on Pro Max. It ends after a few steps north, when the camera starts to follow.
findings.cause: public/act1-hifi/town.html `#pad` (line 109) sits at right 20 px, bottom 76 px + inset; at the gate the camera is held at the map's south edge, so the hero stands two thirds of the way down the screen, and on a 375 px screen the 172 px ring reaches the centre column.
findings.fix: None needed if the ring stays see-through; otherwise let the town camera show 40 px beyond the south edge at the gate.

findings.title: Settings shows the row "Testers: Jump to..." on every size
findings.numbers: One row, every size and language. It is there on purpose for testers; the taste guide says no debug UI in the shipped game, so it is a release gate, not a layout fault.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.js:44 `window.__QOK_TESTERS__ = true` (its comment: set to false for the public App Store release).
findings.fix: Set the flag to false in the release build; this check then reports the entry as fixed and it has to be removed from the list.

findings.title: Menus, title, shop and ending: the strip under the status bar is a slightly different dark
findings.numbers: Strip as high as the top inset in rgb(21,22,28) against the screen's own dark below it, colour step 9 to 13 out of 255: hard to see on dark, behind the notch on phones.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css: the `#qok-ui` column starts below `env(safe-area-inset-top)` and the strip above shows the layer behind it.
findings.fix: Give `#qok-ui .col` the inset as padding-top, not as an offset, so its own background runs to the top.

findings.title: iPad mini: the overworld and dungeons are drawn at half the scale of the other iPads
findings.numbers: iPad mini 744x1133: camera zoom 1, hero 65 px = 8.7% of the width, 15.5 map cells across. iPad 820x1180: zoom 2, hero 130 px = 16%, 8.5 cells. Phones: zoom 1, hero 65 px = 15 to 17%, 7.8 to 9 cells. In the town both iPads use zoom 3.75 (hero 135 px), so on the mini the hero halves when she leaves town. In mm the mini's hero is about as large as a phone's (a CSS px is about 0.18 mm there): whether it reads as too small needs the device.
findings.cause: src/utils/constants.ts:16 `ZOOM = max(1, floor(min(innerWidth * dpr / GAME_WIDTH, ...)))`: 744 x 2 = 1488 falls just under twice the 768 px game width, so the mini stays at 1 where the 820 px iPad gets 2. public/dq-tiles.js:2369 already notes the mini as the one exception.
findings.fix: Pick the zoom from the CSS width (2 from 700 px) rather than from physical pixels. Going by the same note, zoom 2 would also bring the mini back to the 9-chunk ring of the other devices (it notes 12 chunks and about 228 MB at zoom 1 against 190 MB); confirm on the device.

findings.title: iPad landscape battle (by eye): the quiz card is the phone card stretched wide, and the enemy is squeezed between the name bar and the card
findings.numbers: iPad 1180x820: keypad card 846 x 268, keys 206 x 48 (iPad portrait: 468 x 375, keys 110 x 67; phones 75 to 89 x 48); four-button answers 416 x 56; the slime is 249 x 165, 29% of the 865 px name bar (58% in portrait, 68 to 71% on phones). Text in the card is phone size (the card is not zoomed in landscape). Every rule passes: nothing is clipped and the keys are large enough.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css tablet landscape block: `#qok-ui.battle .hudwrap{ margin-top:0; zoom:1; width:100% }` (un-zoomed so that it fits the short height) and `.bstage{ height:52% }`.
findings.fix: Two panes in landscape: enemy and name bar on the left half, quiz card on the right at 520 px wide and zoom 1.3. Smaller step: cap `.hudwrap` at 560 px wide so the keys keep their phone proportions.

findings.title: iPads (by eye): the field HUD, the prompt pill and the town dialogue stay phone size while menus and battle are scaled 1.4
findings.numbers: Same CSS px on every size: HP chip 158 x 42, minimap 156 x 156, compass 68, joystick 172, prompt pill 109 x 48, tab labels 11 px. Town dialogue: 15 px text in a box 804 px (iPad), 1008 px (Pro) or 1164 px (iPad landscape) wide and 104 px high, so a line runs to about 95 to 165 characters; on phones the same text is 5 lines in a 175 px box. In mm these pieces are no smaller than on a phone; against the large screen they look lost, and the dialogue is hard to read as one long line.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css tablet blocks zoom only `#qok-ui` parts (`--z`, `.hudwrap`, `.enemy-card`); `#qok-field-hud`, index.html `#fieldTabs` and `#dpad`, and public/act1-hifi/town.html `#dialogue` (line 76, 15 px) and `#prompt` (line 59) have no tablet rule.
findings.fix: From 700 px of width: `zoom:1.3` on `#qok-field-hud`, `#fieldTabs` and the joystick; town dialogue `max-width:640px; margin:0 auto; font-size:19px`.

findings.title: iPads (by eye): the title screen is the phone layout, not scaled
findings.numbers: From the pictures, iPad Pro 1024x1366: title lettering about 410 px wide (40% of the width; 70% on a phone), hero card about 235 px, Start button about 380 x 56, language switch about 150 px wide; the rest of the screen is empty dark. Create Your Hero, the next screen, is scaled 1.4.
findings.cause: public/ui-overhaul.css: the title column is not inside a `.zc` box, so the tablet `--z` zoom does not apply to it.
findings.fix: Wrap the title stack in `.zc` (or `zoom:var(--z)` on it) so it gets the same 1.4 as the next screen.
